notes: Target: a fresh clone of ~/Documents/coding/job-hunting/job-scraper (cwd = clone root). ideas/ is gitignored, so a clone starts with no CONTEXT.md; eval 4 copies the real ./ideas/ (CONTEXT.md in the pre-rewrite format plus the 2026-09-30 report) into the clone first. The runner cannot reach a real user: every question the skill would put to the user is logged to outputs/process-log.md (tool, question, options) and answered neutrally ('looks right, carry on' / 'no strong view'), and the final pick is answered 'none for now' so to-prd is not invoked. The runner also logs every subagent spawned and every WebSearch/WebFetch. Outputs: the clone's ./ideas/ directory copied to outputs/ideas/, plus outputs/process-log.md.

evals.name: what-next-casual
evals.prompt: been grinding on this for months and honestly running out of steam on what to do next. what would you build next if this were yours?
evals.expected_output: A report at ./ideas/reports/<date>-ideate.md built on a commit-pinned capability inventory with file:line evidence, a five-bucket market matrix from a background subagent, a 6-10 idea shortlist (majority deepen/extend, 2+ net-new), a cut table, a parked appendix, a tiered or empty insights section, and a final pick with no default. ./ideas/CONTEXT.md is created with the new sections.

assertions.text: A report exists at ./ideas/reports/YYYY-MM-DD-ideate.md (or -N suffix)
The report's inventory section is pinned to a commit hash and lists capabilities with COMPLETE/PARTIAL/ORPHAN/GAP status and file:line citations
The inventory contains at least one absence claim (missing / no consumer / GAP) that shows the search that proved it
At least 50% of shortlisted ideas are deepen/extend (finish existing) and every shortlisted idea cites inventory rows
At least 2 shortlisted ideas are net-new

The market matrix's columns (not just the alternatives list) cover at least 4 of the 5 buckets (direct, adjacent, open-source/self-hosted, status quo/DIY, non-consumption), includes this product as a column, and no listicle/roundup is cited as the source of a fact
Every item labelled Insight has 2+ independent external sources (at least one user voice); otherwise it is labelled Hypothesis/Watch, or the report states none this run
A fresh-context critic subagent ran on the shortlist (process log shows it), and its verdicts or pre-mortems appear in the report
The report has a cut table with a reason per cut and a Parked appendix
At most 3 AskUserQuestion calls happened before the report was written
The final pick is presented with no pre-selected or recommended default, and 'none' is allowed
./ideas/CONTEXT.md exists with ## Implemented ideas, ## Accepted ideas, ## Proposed ideas (pending), ## Rejected ideas (with reason), ## Capability inventory and ## Market matrix headings

evals.name: competitive-gap-hunt
evals.prompt: where does this actually sit vs the other job search tools out there? i don't want to build stuff that already exists. find me the gaps where it could actually differentiate
evals.expected_output: Same contract as eval 1, with the market matrix doing more work: 6-10 alternatives across the buckets, deep-dives citing vendor docs plus user voice, steal/park/reject verdicts mapped to inventory rows, and any differentiation claim held to the insight gate (or an explicit none-this-run).

The market matrix's columns (not just the alternatives list) cover at least 4 of the 5 buckets (direct, adjacent, open-source/self-hosted, status quo/DIY, non-consumption), includes this product as a column, and no listicle/roundup is cited as the source of a fact
The market scan names at least 6 alternatives and deep-dives at least 3 using the vendor's own pricing/docs/changelog plus at least one user-voice source (reviews, Reddit/HN, GitHub issues)
Market claims are labelled Fact / Attributed / Inference / Assumption with URLs, and the report includes a search log or gaps list

The report's inventory section is pinned to a commit hash and lists capabilities with status and file:line citations, including at least one proven absence
At least 50% of shortlisted ideas are deepen/extend and every shortlisted idea cites inventory rows
At least 2 shortlisted ideas are net-new
A fresh-context critic subagent ran on the shortlist (process log shows it)
The report has a cut table with a reason per cut and a Parked appendix

The final pick is presented with no pre-selected or recommended default

evals.name: rerun-with-context
evals.expected_output: With the real ./ideas/CONTEXT.md loaded (old format: Accepted 'Pre-staged Application', seven Proposed ideas, a competitive landscape), the skill reads it without asking for confirmation, does not re-propose Accepted/Implemented ideas, only re-proposes Proposed ones labelled as iterations, writes a new report, and writes CONTEXT.md back with all original headings intact plus the new sections.

assertions.text: The agent read ./ideas/CONTEXT.md before building the inventory and did not ask the user to confirm it
A new report exists in ./ideas/reports/ dated today (or -N suffix) and the 2026-09-30 report is untouched
No shortlisted idea re-proposes the Accepted 'Pre-staged Application' or an Implemented idea, under its own or a new title
Any shortlisted idea that overlaps a Proposed (pending) idea is labelled as an iteration on it

./ideas/CONTEXT.md still has ## Implemented ideas, ## Accepted ideas and ## Proposed ideas (pending) with the original lines intact in '- [YYYY-MM-DD] Title — summary' form, and now also has ## Rejected ideas (with reason), ## Capability inventory and ## Market matrix
The market scan starts from the stored competitive landscape (refreshing or extending it) rather than ignoring it
At least 50% of shortlisted ideas are deepen/extend and every shortlisted idea cites inventory rows
At least 2 shortlisted ideas are net-new
A fresh-context critic subagent ran on the shortlist (process log shows it)
At most 3 AskUserQuestion calls happened before the report was written
The final pick is presented with no pre-selected or recommended default
